summary: Some homes invite a child's opinion on the news while others ask the child to defer for harmony.
realLife: A professor summarizes two family styles. Concept-oriented homes encourage children to voice opinions and discuss issues, linked to more interest and news use. Socio-oriented homes stress harmony and deference, and children there may see less disagreement.
gates: The household includes a child who follows the news.
inGame: Household members and news stories read could carry it.
